original_ai_output.title_zh: 赞比亚主教在选举后突袭中被拘，其子担忧父亲安全
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据BBC报道，赞比亚反对派政治人物、前博茨瓦纳主教特雷弗·姆万巴在8月14日安全部队突袭后与其他10名反对派人士一同被拘留，并被控叛国罪。其子埃诺·姆万巴表示担忧父亲的安全。政府指控反对派策划武装叛乱，被拘留政界人士否认指控。

key_facts.fact: 赞比亚反对派政治人物、前博茨瓦纳主教特雷弗·姆万巴与其他10名反对派人士被当局拘留
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the former Bishop of Botswana was detained along with 10 other opposition figures by authorities

key_facts.fact: 姆万巴被控叛国罪，其子埃诺·姆万巴对BBC表示担忧父亲安全
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: has been charged with treason following President Hakainde Hichilema's disputed election victory

key_facts.fact: 反对派人士自8月14日安全部队突袭以来一直被拘留
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The opposition politicians have been held since a raid by security forces on 14 August

key_facts.fact: 政府指控反对派策划武装叛乱，被拘留政界人士否认指控
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The government accuses the opposition of planning an armed insurgency and have charged the detained politicians with treason. They have denied the charges
